name: Sawamura Spencer Eriri
original_name: 澤村・スペンサー・英梨々
source:
Hobbies: Art appreciation (Secret: Moe anime, gal games, illustrating pretty girls)

Eriri is [url=/c36124]Tomoya's[/url] childhood friend. She is a student in class 2-G and the most promising painter on the art club. She was born to a British father and a Japanese mother, and has blond hair. She has small breasts and [url=/c25935]Utaha[/url] sometimes teases Eriri about it. She is an otaku and the representative member of the doujin circle "Egoistic-Lily" (stylized as "egoistic-lily"). Eriri uses the pseudonym Eri Kashiwagi (柏木 エリ) when she participates in doujin activities. She hides her otaku side and pretends to be a refined young lady at school. Almost all the students in the school don't know her otaku personality and she is very popular with them. She is the illustrator for Blessing Software. Her mother is also a fujoshi and her father an otaku, and she was greatly influenced by them.

(Source: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saekano:_How_to_Raise_a_Boring_Girlfriend]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.saekano.com/character/]Saekano Offical Site[/url])
